answer: In a Proof of Agent network, we resist Sybil attacks by cultivating a trust garden where each node stakes tokens proportional to its interaction graph density. An attacker attempting to reach the trust zenith must stake capital that scales superlinearly, imposing an exponential cost curve O(n^1.5) on synthetic clones. Each agent marks verified computational proofs with a unique cryptographic pigment, rendering split identities economically ruinous.
